name: Swearing in Ceremony of Stephan Hunt, Chief of Police
agenda_text:
The City of Azusa City Council,
along with the Azusa Police Department,
  cordially invites you to attend the
  Swearing In Ceremony of

  Stephan Hunt
  as the new Chief of Police

  Monday, November 21, 2016
  5:00pm

  Azusa Auditorium
  213 East Foothill Blvd., Azusa

  Reception immediately following at:
  Azusa Senior Center
  740 North Dalton Avenue, Azusa

  Questions: Contact Michelle Feghali
  626-812-3298
  mfeghali@ci.azusa.ca.us
